data: NVIDIA reported net income of about $9.75 billion ($9,752 million) for fiscal 2022, which ended January 30, 2022, and about $29.76 billion ($29,760 million) for fiscal 2024, which ended January 28, 2024. That is an increase of roughly $20.0 billion, or about 205%, meaning net income roughly tripled over the two years. The path was uneven. Net income fell to about $4.37 billion in fiscal 2023 before surging in fiscal 2024 on demand for its data center AI products.
